scores.visual_critic_note: Cohesive dark theme with a deliberate single-accent palette (#4477AA used consistently) and clean grid layout show real design intent, but the color scatter plot renders as near-invisible tiny dots against the dark background and the typography hierarchy is uniformly flat across all panel text.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Honest encoding throughout: zero-baseline bar chart, scaleSqrt used correctly for both network node radii and color scatter radii, data-driven domains via d3.extent/d3.max, and hardcoded hue [0,360] and lightness [0,100] axes are physically bounded ranges rather than deceptive truncation.
scores.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag pattern correctly coalesces all renders, no transitions to interrupt, pointer events unify mouse/touch, and no cross-view feedback loops exist; the only weakness is that bitFilter.set() and bitFilter.filtered() run synchronously in the brush handler on every mousemove before the RAF-deferred draw, though the bitwise typed-array ops are fast enough at 34K records to be unlikely to cause perceptible jank.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Four linked views form a coherent filter pipeline (timeline→network→color→list) with a restrained single-hue palette and pre-computed force layout, but the color scatter's dense dot cloud is hard to parse without interaction and the 60-node network approaches spaghetti at this panel size.
flags: Synchronous O(N) bitFilter recomputation on every brush mousemove (not RAF-deferred)
